title: PWA: insert LOOP/ROUND/FOREACH_TASK blocks
notes: Add UI controls to create container blocks (LOOP, ROUND, FOREACH_TASK) directly in the Blocks view (not only by hand-editing script). Support setting/editing repeat for LOOP/ROUND (reuse existing repeat editor), and ensure indent/outdent + drag-reorder works with the new containers. Canonical artifact remains the formatted script: any UI change must immediately update `pipeline.script` textarea via AST->script render.
acceptance: User can insert a `ROUND` or `FOREACH_TASK` container from the Blocks UI and the canonical script updates immediately with correct 2-space indentation.
User can edit LOOP/ROUND repeat counts and the script updates immediately; invalid repeats show localized inline feedback.
All new UI strings are localized for 11 UI languages and Arabic remains RTL-safe.
